svg.title: Insertion sort on eight lines: each line in turn slides left past the bigger ones before it
svg.text: the array of lines, one insertion at a time

g.title: The eight lines as read. v[0..1), the first line alone, is in order: there is nothing to compare it with.
i = 1: "sherlock" slides left past 1 line, reaching the front: 1 comparison, 1 in all. v[0..2) is in order.
i = 2: "holmes" slides left past 2 lines, reaching the front: 2 comparisons, 3 in all. v[0..3) is in order.
i = 3: "she" slides left past 2 lines, and stops at "holmes": 3 comparisons, 6 in all. v[0..4) is in order.
i = 4: "is" slides left past 3 lines, and stops at "holmes": 4 comparisons, 10 in all. v[0..5) is in order.
i = 5: "always" slides left past 5 lines, reaching the front: 5 comparisons, 15 in all. v[0..6) is in order.
i = 6: "the" slides left past 1 line, and stops at "sherlock": 2 comparisons, 17 in all. v[0..7) is in order.
i = 7: "woman" is not smaller than "to", so it stays: 1 comparison, 18 in all. v[0..8) is in order.
